opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the award duration, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation; may include up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research) supporting interdisciplinary research at the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, with up to £10,000 for public engagement.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs; seed funding available for collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: FEC regime; Academy funds 80% of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC, for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation; British citizens and EEA nationals eligible, or anyone with a UK doctorate, or with strong prior association with the UK academic community; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research, strengthening their research and teaching experience.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution (HEI) or Independent Research Organisation (IRO) for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (e.g. quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute holding an established role for the award duration, of postdoctoral or above status; involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based humanities/social sciences researchers with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, spanning SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, producing policy-relevant analysis.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, support to make an application), in addition to research expenses.
